issues: Scene presents Lehi speaking to his sons in the wilderness, consistent with verses 2–4; the imagined wilderness is correctly kept distinct. Visual details of the sons and setting remain unspecified.

The summary and dialogue are supported by verses 15–16. The gesture’s direction is unspecified; the visual-inference wording appropriately presents it as an option.
The narrator's identity is not specified by the scene's cited verses; its label as an unnamed first-person narrator is appropriately cautious.

The field's comparison to a world is figurative and appropriately not presented as a literal world.
The observer's identity is unspecified in these verses; the description remains unnamed.
The approach and beginning on the path are distinct actions within the cited sequence and should not be collapsed into a different chronology.

The scene correctly places Lehi’s words and actions after he finishes recounting the vision. Lehi’s fear and exhortation are supported by verses 36–38; the family’s arrangement and expressions are unspecified.
